title: Grateful Dead Live at The Scope on 1982-04-03
lineage: Up Front Audience, Sennheiser 441 Microphones > Cassette Master > DAT (via Fostex D-10 Playback) > CD-R (hhb 800 Standalone) > EAC 0.9 > WAV > CDRWAV (for track recutting)>SHN (via MKWACT)

ai_review.summary: High‑energy show with stellar Eyes, Scarlet > Fire and CC Rider captured on a lively audience (Sennheiser) tape that’s generally clear but has occasional mic drop‑outs.
ai_review.review: The concert is remembered for an explosive second set – Eyes, Scarlet > Fire, Althea, CC Rider, NFA and Stella all receive glowing praise – and the band’s chemistry feels especially tight with Jerry’s rapid noodling and Brent’s interstellar keys. The recording is an audience (AUD) tape taken with a Sennheiser mic; most listeners find it surprisingly clear and full‑bodied, though a few note a missing Jerry vocal mic early in Eyes and some uneven balance. Overall the performance outweighs the modest technical flaws, making this a must‑listen for early‑80s Dead fans.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 20 detailed reviews overwhelmingly praise the musical performance (high energy, many standout songs) and describe the audience recording as good to excellent despite minor drop‑outs; weighted average of show (≈4.5) and recording (≈4.0) yields ~4.3.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sennheiser mic in the pit provides a lively, immersive feel; sound is generally clear with good instrument separation. Minor issues: Jerry's vocal mic drops out early in Eyes and occasional balance unevenness noted by a few reviewers.

poor_songs: End of second set (some feel it was less smoking)
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set builds nicely with Althea and Estimated, then a high‑octane second set that peaks on Scarlet > Fire and continues strong through Eyes, NFA and Stella.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Shreds throughout, especially fast‑tempo Eyes; interplay with Brent highlighted; mic dropout early in Eyes noted.
band_member_comments.Phil: Powerful bass work praised but often buried in audience tape – fans wish for a better SBD source to hear his lines clearly.
band_member_comments.Bob: Rhythm guitar loud and clear; many reviewers specifically enjoyed his playing on this night.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent (keys) delivers interstellar overdrive, especially during Scarlet > Fire and the jam sections.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill (drums) provides solid, building‑shaking energy on Scarlet > Fire; overall drumming described as strong.
